_doc: The ONE list of guiding prose: each text that tells an agent how to act. Read by guiding_prose.py (page design/specs/2026-11-23-guiding-prose-check/boundary.md). `files`: globs, matched by path segment (a * never crosses a /). `left_out`: a file of the rewrite census that is not guiding prose, with its reason. A brief that detached_helper.py launches is guiding prose too; it has no path, so it is not a glob.

left_out.design/RimMandrake/CLAUDE.history.md: a record of measurements and owner words moved out of CLAUDE.md; it gives no rule
left_out.infrastructure/DETERMINISM_ASSESSMENT.md: an assessment at its date; it gives no rule
left_out.LEXICON.md: the glossary itself: it defines each term
